fee_notes: Standard fee $49,750; $24,875 for additional units, veterans (VetFran), first responders, and officers/directors. During last fiscal year, fees collected ranging from $1,000 to $49,750.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an initial franchise fee of $49,750 for the right to establish a single FASTSIGNS Center under a Franchise Agreement. The initial franchise fee, if you establish an additional FASTSIGNS Center, is $24,875. We offer a reduced initial franchise fee of $24,875 to veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces who meet the requirements of the VetFran Program, a 50% discount.
